description: 공항 (npm: @justin06lee/gonghang) is a zero-dependency TypeScript library that lets independently running components exchange typed messages and request/answer calls through a shared contract type. It is meant to be dropped into any project as a ports-and-adapters layer, with the transport (same process, worker, WebSocket, child process, TCP) swapped by changing one line.
features: Typed send/on and ask/answer over a shared contract type
Pluggable adapters: memory, worker, broadcast, websocket, lines, custom
Custom adapter from two functions: send and listen
Opt-in relay forwarding frames between adapters
Optional stack traces sent back with errors
tap and onError hooks for observing traffic and failures
Zero dependencies in a single source file
Runnable worker, child process, and WebSocket examples

layers.name: Port API
layers.what: connect, send, on, once, ask, answer, close; the only surface apps touch

layers.name: Adapters
layers.what: Transport plugins that move JSON frames: memory, worker, broadcast, websocket, lines, custom

layers.name: Transports
layers.what: Bun or Node runtime primitives: Worker, WebSocket, stdio streams, TCP sockets

flows.name: Send and receive a message
steps: Contract type declares the message name and payload
Adapter listen delivers frame to receiving port

flows.name: Ask and answer a question
steps: port.ask(name, input) creates a request frame with an id
Adapter transmits request to the answering port
Reply frame with the same id returns over the adapter
ask promise resolves, or rejects on error or timeout

layout: src/index.ts — the whole library: port API and all adapters
test/contract.ts — shared contract used by tests
test/port.test.ts — core messaging and ask/answer tests
test/adapters.test.ts — adapter tests over real transports
README.md — usage guide with snippets from tests and examples
docs/guide.md — reader guide: concepts, full API, failure modes, options, code map
docs/diagrams/ — SVG diagrams used by the guide
package.json — package metadata, scoped name @justin06lee/gonghang, version 0.1.0
